checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals email-sequence-build, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals email-sequence-build; description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The sequence is assembled and never sends or schedules a live send on its own.
checks.rule: Steps and hard rules state the sequence is assembled, not sending, and the build never sends on its own.

checks.description: Blocked on the email and WhatsApp platform OPEN ITEM until the platform is confirmed and approved.
checks.rule: Body and hard rules require the platform to be confirmed and approved and forbid assuming a platform.

checks.description: staged_structure covers messages, triggers, delays, audience, and suppression.
checks.rule: Output staged_structure includes messages, triggers, delays, audience, and suppression.

checks.description: The build assembles any sequence-standards pattern (welcome, onboarding, event, nonpayer, winback) without redesigning it.
checks.rule: Body and template state the build assembles any pattern from skills/07-lifecycle-messaging/templates/sequence-standards.md and carries its design through unchanged.

checks.description: The assembled sequence preserves the pattern's triggers (time-based or behavior-triggered) and cadence, and stays not-sending until approved.
checks.rule: Each message carries its trigger marked time-based or behavior-triggered, its delay and cadence are preserved from the source pattern, and the sequence is assembled paused and not sending until the human gate approves.

checks.description: Each message binds to a copy-package variant id and a paired subject line; no free copy.
checks.rule: Steps and template bind every message to a copy-package variant id and subject line and forbid invented copy.

checks.description: Suppression is applied and no personal or sensitive data appears in any link.
checks.rule: Hard rules apply suppression (paying, unsubscribed, excluded) and forbid personal or sensitive data in links.

checks.description: No invented audience, schedule, titles, names, offers, or prices; missing means stop and ask.
checks.rule: Output traces audience and schedule to the lifecycle-package and brief and invents no titles, names, offers, or prices.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash glyph, no tatweel (U+0640), and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).

checks.description: Output populates the staged_structure and checklist of the paid-launch-package for the sequence.
checks.rule: Output is described as the staged_structure and checklist of the paid-launch-package per handoff-contract.md.
